# Extract Comprehensive Feature-Level (Gene / Peak) Properties

Computes mean abundance, standard deviation, variance, scaled variance
(z-score standardized variance), coefficient of variation (CV), feature
dropout (zero fraction), dispersion, Biological Coefficient of Variation
(BCV), gene-gene correlations, and outlier proportions.

## Usage

``` r
extract_feature_properties(
  data,
  n_top_cor = 500,
  modality = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

## Arguments

- data:

  Count matrix (features x cells) or `SingleCellExperiment` object.

- n_top_cor:

  Number of top HVGs/HVPs to use for correlation matrix (default 500,
  matching SimBench).

- modality:

  Optional modality string (e.g. `"scRNA-seq"`, `"scATAC-seq"`). When
  ATAC/peaks are provided or auto-detected, feature summaries and
  pairwise peak-peak correlations are computed after Signac/simPIC
  TF-IDF transformation instead of `log2(CPM + 1)`.

- verbose:

  Logical, whether to print progress messages.

## Value

A named list of 11 feature-level property summaries:

- mean_expression:

  Numeric vector of normalized mean abundances per feature.

- variance:

  Numeric vector of normalized variances per feature.

- scaled_variance:

  Numeric vector of z-score standardized normalized variances.

- sd:

  Numeric vector of normalized standard deviations per feature.

- cv:

  Numeric vector of raw coefficient of variation percentages per
  feature.

- zero_fraction_feature:

  Numeric vector of per-feature zero proportions.

- detection_freq_feature:

  Numeric vector of per-feature detection rates
  (`1 - zero_fraction_feature`).

- dispersion:

  Numeric vector of raw variance-to-mean ratios.

- bcv:

  Numeric vector of empirical Biological Coefficient of Variation
  estimates.

- gene_cor:

  Numeric vector of upper-triangle pairwise Spearman correlations across
  top variable features.

- prop_outliers_feature:

  Numeric scalar proportion of features flagged as total-count outliers
  via Tukey IQR.

## Examples

``` r
data(example_scrna, package = "scSimEval")
extract_feature_properties(example_scrna$ref)
```
